description: KNa₂LiZr₂(Si₂O₅)₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cccm space group. K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 3.08-3.10 Å. Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.49 Å) and two longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Li-O bond lengths are 2.01 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 30°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.65 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one K and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms.
